name: Moises
summary: App for musicians to separate stems, remove vocals, practise, master and remix tracks.
description: Moises is a toolkit for musicians that separates songs into stems such as vocals, drums and bass, detects chords and tempo, and supports practice, mastering and remixing. Moises Studio adds collaborative music making. It runs on the web, desktop and mobile.

howToUse.title: Open Moises
howToUse.description: Open Moises in the browser, or download the desktop or mobile app, and sign up.

howToUse.title: Separate a song into stems
howToUse.description: Upload a song. Moises separates it into stems such as vocals, drums and bass so you can mute the part you play.

howToUse.title: Practice, master or remix
howToUse.description: Use the musicians' toolkit as it detects chords and tempo, then practice, master or remix the track.

howToUse.title: Collaborate in Moises Studio
howToUse.description: Start a Moises Studio session for collaborative music making: arrange, record and edit the same session with other people in the browser.
